description: Analyze raw tool output you captured yourself (e.g. `sudo strace …`, `sudo fs_usage …`, `perf script`, `py-spy dump`, `lsof -F`, `tcpdump -nn -tt -r`) and turn it into the same evidence and findings Debug Anything would produce. Use when Debug Anything could not run the tool (no root, macOS).

duration_s.description: How long the capture ran, when the file has no timestamps (profiles)

path.description: Path to the raw output file you captured yourself (e.g. with sudo)

name: import_artifact
title: import_artifact
